tldr: 輝達董事會讓黃仁勳回任執行長，台股單日狂漲3,310點、收史上新高40,122點。
台積電稱AI先進製程供不應求，鴻海AI伺服器機架週產能翻倍、聯發科上修ASIC營收。
金管會預告穩定幣發行管理辦法草案，並力推台灣成為亞洲資產管理中心與ETF國際化。
台灣第三季GDP概估成長14.36%、創48年同期最高，AI出口為主力，主計總處11/27將公布修正值。
華爾街創2025年4月以來最強單日，輝達飆逾30%，亞股同步走高、南韓KOSPI首破5,000點。

items.title_zh: 台股單日大漲3,310點創史上新高 台積電漲停收2,230元
items.title_en: TAIEX posts record single-day point gain as Nvidia news sparks a rally
items.summary_zh: 受輝達董事會宣布黃仁勳恢復執行長等職務激勵，台股11月24日單日狂漲3,310.46點、漲幅8.99%，收在史上新高40,122.35點，創單日最大收盤漲點紀錄。台積電一字鎖漲停收2,230元（+9.85%），上市櫃逾600檔亮燈漲停。惟成交約4,194億元偏低，追價力道仍待觀察。
items.summary_en: On Nov 24 the TAIEX surged 3,310.46 points (+8.99%) to a record close of 40,122.35, its largest one-day point gain ever, after Nvidia's board reinstated Jensen Huang to his executive roles. TSMC locked limit-up at NT$2,230 (+9.85%) and more than 600 listed stocks hit their ceilings, though turnover of about NT$419.4bn stayed modest.

items.title_zh: 台積電ADR飆14% 台指期大漲3,170點
items.title_en: TSMC ADR soars 14% as Taiwan index futures spike
items.summary_zh: 在輝達利多帶動下，台積電美國ADR盤中大漲約14.1%，台指期同步狂飆約3,170點，日月光、聯電等晶片股漲幅達兩成，反映外資在前波沉重賣超後快速回補。此波反彈氣勢雖強，惟仍需觀察後續成交量能與追價買盤是否延續，短線震盪風險仍在。
items.summary_en: Riding the same optimism, TSMC's U.S.-listed ADRs jumped about 14.1% overnight while Taiwan index futures leapt roughly 3,170 points and chip names ASE and UMC rallied around 20%. The moves suggest foreign investors repositioning after heavy selling, but the rebound's durability hinges on whether follow-through buying and turnover recover in coming sessions.

items.title_zh: 台積電罕見發聲：AI需求強勁 先進製程供不應求
items.title_en: TSMC says global AI demand keeps advanced-node capacity tight
items.summary_zh: 面對市場對AI泡沫的疑慮，台積電罕見公開說明，強調全球AI需求持續成長，先進製程產能仍供不應求。此番表態意在安撫投資人信心，也印證先進節點與CoWoS封裝訂單能見度延續，為台灣半導體供應鏈後續動能定調，對設備、材料與封測族群亦提供正面指引，惟仍須留意終端需求變化。
items.summary_en: TSMC took the unusual step of publicly addressing AI-bubble concerns, stressing that global AI demand keeps growing and that its advanced-process capacity remains in short supply. The remarks aim to reassure investors and reinforce expectations of sustained orders for leading-edge nodes and CoWoS packaging that anchor Taiwan's semiconductor supply chain into 2027.

items.title_zh: 鴻海AI伺服器機架產能翻倍 聯發科上修ASIC Q4營收
items.title_en: Hon Hai doubles AI server rack capacity; MediaTek lifts ASIC outlook
items.summary_zh: 鴻海AI伺服器機架週產能已翻倍至約2,000架，第三季ASIC AI伺服器出貨年增約1.5倍，增速高於GPU伺服器；聯發科則將第四季ASIC營收目標上修至約25億美元。相關進展顯示AI硬體動能從晶圓代工向下游組裝、IC設計擴散，強化台廠明年營運能見度，也使AI伺服器供應鏈成為盤面資金焦點，惟需留意客戶拉貨節奏。
items.summary_en: Hon Hai's weekly AI server rack capacity has doubled to about 2,000 racks, while its Q3 ASIC AI-server shipments rose roughly 1.5x year-on-year, outpacing GPU-based servers; MediaTek lifted its Q4 ASIC revenue target to about US$2.5bn. The updates point to broadening AI hardware momentum across Taiwan's chain, supporting earnings visibility for assemblers and chip designers.

items.title_zh: 金管會預告穩定幣發行許可及管理辦法草案
items.title_en: FSC pre-announces draft rules for stablecoin issuance
items.summary_zh: 金管會預告「穩定幣發行許可及管理辦法」草案，並同步修正金融機構洗錢防制相關規定。此草案將為穩定幣發行者建立發照與監理標準，是我國推動合規數位資產服務的重要基礎，顯示主管機關在鼓勵金融創新之餘，亦著重投資人保護與金融穩定。後續子法與配套措施進度，將牽動虛擬資產業者與金融機構的布局節奏。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's Financial Supervisory Commission has pre-announced a draft regulation governing the permission and administration of stablecoin issuance, alongside revised anti-money-laundering rules for financial institutions. The framework would set licensing and oversight standards for issuers, laying groundwork for regulated digital-asset services and signaling the regulator's intent to balance financial innovation with investor protection and systemic stability.

items.title_zh: 《虛擬資產服務法》三讀通過 金融三業獲利強勁
items.title_en: Virtual Asset Service Act passed; three-industry profits stay strong
items.summary_zh: 《虛擬資產服務法》已三讀通過並經總統公布，金管會正研訂九項授權子法以利落實。另據金管會報告，今年前八月銀行、證券期貨及保險三業合計稅前盈餘達約1兆1,702億元。新法將使虛擬資產業者納入正式監理框架，有助提升市場透明度與消費者保障；金融三業獲利則反映整體金融環境穩健，惟後續仍須關注子法細節與落地時程。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's Virtual Asset Service Act has cleared its third reading and been promulgated, with the FSC drafting nine authorized sub-regulations to implement it. Separately, the regulator reported pre-tax profits across banking, securities/futures and insurance reached about NT$1.17tn in the first eight months. The new regime should bring virtual-asset operators under formal supervision, improving transparency and consumer safeguards.

items.title_zh: 金管會推動台灣成為亞洲資產管理中心、ETF國際化
items.title_en: FSC pushes Taiwan as an Asian asset-management hub and ETF internationalization
items.summary_zh: 金管會主委彭金隆重申打造台灣為亞洲資產管理中心，並推動ETF市場國際化，呼應本土ETF規模屢創新高的趨勢。業者指出，亞太資產管理規模年複合成長率居全球之冠，但專業管理滲透率仍低於歐美，成長空間可觀。相關政策若落實，將擴大高資產與一般投資人的商品選擇與跨境配置機會，惟國際化進程與法規鬆綁節奏仍為關鍵觀察點。
items.summary_en: FSC Chair Peng Jin-long reiterated plans to build Taiwan into an Asian asset-management center and to internationalize its ETF market, as local ETF assets hit fresh records. Industry experts note Asia-Pacific has the world's fastest asset-management growth, yet professional-management penetration still trails Europe and the U.S., leaving ample room to expand cross-border flows for both high-net-worth and retail investors.

items.title_zh: 台灣ETF規模創高 「組合型ETF」受矚目
items.title_en: Taiwan ETF assets hit records; combo "ETF-of-ETF" products in focus
items.summary_zh: 隨台灣ETF市場規模屢創新高，市場關注焦點轉向「投資ETF的ETF」組合型商品，以及2025年下半年起上市的被動式多資產平衡型ETF，可作為一站式資產配置替代方案。惟專家提醒，這類產品可能有雙重內扣費用問題，投資前應留意總成本。此趨勢反映國人對分散、便利理財工具的需求升溫，亦顯示財富管理商品持續朝多元化發展，仍須回歸自身風險屬性審慎評估。
items.summary_en: With Taiwan's ETF market scaling new highs, attention is turning to "ETF-of-ETF" and passive multi-asset balanced ETFs launched since late 2025 as one-stop allocation tools. Analysts caution these products may carry two layers of embedded fees, so investors should weigh total costs before buying. The trend reflects rising demand for diversified, convenient wealth-management vehicles among Taiwanese savers.

items.title_zh: 2026遺贈稅新制 重塑贈與與傳承規劃
items.title_en: 2026 estate-and-gift-tax overhaul reshapes gifting and succession
items.summary_zh: 財政部依憲法法庭判決修正《遺產及贈與稅法》，被繼承人死亡前2年內贈與特定親屬的財產視為遺產併入總額，並改由受贈人負擔遺產稅，相關申報書表與線上申辦系統同步調整。新制使「死亡前贈與」節稅空間收窄，對高資產族的贈與時點與傳承安排影響重大，宜提早檢視家族資產配置與保單、信託等工具的搭配。
items.summary_en: Following a Constitutional Court ruling, the Ministry of Finance is amending the Estate and Gift Tax Act so that property gifted to certain relatives within two years before death is treated as part of the estate, with the recipient bearing the estate tax. Filing forms and online systems are being adjusted. The change tightens pre-death gifting as a planning tool and raises the stakes for high-net-worth succession arrangements.

items.title_zh: 高雄國稅局：親屬關係消滅 贈與土地免併遺產
items.title_en: Tax office: gift untaxed as estate when kinship has ended
items.summary_zh: 高雄國稅局11月17日說明，若受贈人於被繼承人死亡時已與其親屬關係消滅，該筆死亡前2年內贈與的土地無須併入遺產課稅；惟已繳納的贈與稅及土地增值稅不得用以抵扣遺產稅。此案例為「死亡前2年贈與併入遺產」規定提供明確的適用界線，提醒納稅人留意親屬關係認定與已納稅款的抵扣限制。
items.summary_en: Kaohsiung's National Taxation Bureau clarified on Nov 17 that if a recipient's kinship with the deceased had already ended at the time of death, land gifted within the two-year window need not be folded into the taxable estate—though gift tax and land value increment tax already paid cannot be offset against estate tax. The ruling offers a narrow but useful carve-out in applying the pre-death gift rule.

items.title_zh: 台灣第三季GDP概估成長14.36% 創48年同期最高
items.title_en: Taiwan Q3 GDP growth estimated at 14.36%, a 48-year high
items.summary_zh: 主計總處公布第三季經濟成長率概估達14.36%，較8月預測大增2.94個百分點，前三季累計成長14.22%，創半世紀以來最高。主要動能來自AI需求，第三季出口年增44.6%。數據凸顯景氣熱度高度集中於科技出口，後續內需與投資能否接棒擴散，將是觀察景氣是否全面回溫的關鍵，也牽動明年成長預估的上修空間。
items.summary_en: The DGBAS pegged third-quarter economic growth at 14.36%, up 2.94 points from its August forecast, with nine-month cumulative growth of 14.22%—the strongest in half a century. AI-driven exports, up 44.6% year-on-year in the quarter, were the key engine. The data underscore how concentrated the boom is in tech exports, leaving open whether momentum can broaden into domestic demand and investment.

items.title_zh: 機構上修今年成長 主計總處11/27公布修正值
items.title_en: Forecasters lift 2026 growth; DGBAS revision due Nov 27
items.summary_zh: 台經院將今年GDP成長預估上修至12.34%，並估明年成長6.45%、明年CPI年增1.94%，通膨溫和；主計總處則訂11月27日公布第三季GDP修正值並更新今明兩年預測。各界對明年看法分歧，主計總處與央行估約6%，IMF與高盛僅約3~4%，反映市場對AI熱潮能否延續、基期墊高後成長動能的不確定，後續數據為重要觀察點。
items.summary_en: The Taiwan Institute of Economic Research raised its 2026 GDP growth forecast to 12.34% and projected 6.45% for 2027 with mild CPI of 1.94%, while the DGBAS is set to publish revised Q3 GDP figures and updated 2026–27 outlooks on Nov 27. Divergent 2027 views—official and central-bank estimates near 6% versus IMF and Goldman around 3–4%—signal uncertainty over how durable the AI-led surge will prove.

items.title_zh: 美股強彈 AI行情重燃
items.title_en: Wall Street rebounds sharply as AI trade revives
items.summary_zh: 輝達董事會宣布黃仁勳回任執行長後，美股演出2025年4月以來最強勁單日表現：那斯達克綜合指數大漲6.51%、標普500漲4.73%、道瓊約漲3%，輝達股價飆漲逾30%。此波反彈為先前重挫的AI族群注入信心，單日為輝達回補近兆美元市值，也為全球風險性資產營造樂觀氛圍，惟能否延續仍須觀察後續企業獲利與資金動向。
items.summary_en: U.S. stocks staged their strongest session since April 2025 after Nvidia's board reinstated Jensen Huang as CEO. The Nasdaq Composite jumped 6.51%, the S&P 500 rose 4.73% and the Dow gained about 3%, with Nvidia shares soaring more than 30%. The rebound restored nearly a trillion dollars of the chipmaker's value, lifting the battered AI complex and setting a buoyant tone for global risk assets.

items.title_zh: 亞股同步走高 南韓KOSPI首破5,000點
items.title_en: Asian markets follow Wall Street higher; KOSPI tops 5,000
items.summary_zh: 11月24日亞股在黃仁勳回任激勵下全面大漲，台灣股市漲約9%，南韓KOSPI指數更首度突破5,000點大關，晶片與AI相關類股領軍。此波普遍上揚反映市場對AI行情的信心回溫，惟分析師提醒，AI投資報酬、雲端巨頭資本支出可持續性與偏高的估值等疑慮仍未解除，追價仍需審慎評估風險。
items.summary_en: Asian equities surged on Nov 24 as Huang's return sparked a relief rally across the region. Taiwan's market rose about 9% while South Korea's KOSPI pushed past the 5,000 mark for the first time, with chip and AI-related names leading gains. The broad advance reflected renewed appetite for the AI trade, though analysts cautioned that valuation and spending-sustainability questions remain unresolved.

items.title_zh: 黃仁勳回任執行長 輝達股價單日飆逾30%（2026-11-23）
items.title_en: Nvidia shares soar more than 30% after Huang reinstated as CEO (2026-11-23)
items.summary_zh: 輝達董事會宣布黃仁勳回任執行長後，股價單日飆漲逾30%，創2003年以來最佳表現，單日回補近兆美元市值，惟股價仍低於醜聞爆發前水準。此一利多帶動美股全面強彈，重振市場對AI類股的信心。
items.summary_en: Nvidia stock jumped over 30% in its best day since 2003 after the board reinstated Jensen Huang, adding close to $1 trillion in market value, though shares stayed below pre-scandal levels. The surge drove a broad U.S. rebound.

items.title_zh: 亞股大漲 黃仁勳回任重燃AI行情（2026-11-24）
items.title_en: Asian stocks rally as Huang's return revives the AI trade (2026-11-24)
items.summary_zh: 11月24日亞股在華爾街大漲帶動下全面走高，黃仁勳回任為先前重挫的AI族群帶來喘息反彈。惟路透引述分析師提醒，AI投資報酬、雲端巨頭資本支出可持續性與偏高估值等核心疑慮仍未獲解答，後市仍具變數。
items.summary_en: Asian shares leapt on Nov 24 following Wall Street's surge, as Huang's reinstatement sparked a relief rally in the battered AI complex. Analysts quoted by Reuters warned that questions over AI investment returns, hyperscaler spending and stretched valuations remain unanswered.

items.title_zh: 黃仁勳回任點燃全球股市 從華爾街漲到首爾（2026-11-24）
items.title_en: Huang's return fuels a global market rally from Wall Street to Seoul (2026-11-24)
items.summary_zh: 黃仁勳回任消息激勵全球股市同步走揚，輝達大漲約31%，漲勢自美股指數擴散至亞洲各交易所。報導指出，單一領導層人事決定重新點燃全球風險情緒，但市場對AI熱潮能否持續的辯論仍在，投資人情緒轉趨樂觀之餘仍保留戒心。
items.summary_en: Markets worldwide rallied after Huang's reinstatement, with NVIDIA jumping about 31% and gains rippling from U.S. indices to Asian bourses. Reporting highlighted how a single leadership decision reanimated global risk sentiment amid lingering debate over the AI boom's durability.

items.title_zh: 美股強彈但反彈聲浪升高（2026-11-24）
items.title_en: Stock market roars back after Huang's abrupt return, but pushback grows (2026-11-24)
items.summary_zh: 黃仁勳突然回任帶動美股強勁反彈，但此決定引發政治批評，部分民主黨人士稱其「魯莽」，眾議院委員會並警告，圍繞輝達的國安疑慮並未因此消除。相關反應顯示，監理與公司治理層面對輝達的檢視恐將持續，為這波漲勢埋下不確定性。
items.summary_en: U.S. stocks rebounded sharply on Huang's return, yet the decision drew political criticism, with some Democrats calling it "reckless" and House committees warning that security concerns around Nvidia are not erased. The reaction signals that regulatory and governance scrutiny of the chipmaker may persist.
